name: RemainingDispensations
title: Remaining dispensations
description: The number of dispensations a prescription item has left, as the member that holds the prescription states it. `MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.numberOfRepeatsAllowed` is the number authorised; no element of FHIR R4 or of the HL7 Europe Medication Prescription and Dispense profiles carries the number left.
